// 1. Query bead store for ready, unassigned beads.\n        let filters = Filters {\n            assignee: None,\n            exclude_labels: self.exclude_labels.clone(),\n        };\n\n        tracing::debug!(\n            filters = ?filters,\n            \"Querying bead store for ready candidates\"\n        );\n\n        let mut candidates = match store.ready(&filters).await {\n            Ok(beads) => {\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    count = beads.len(),\n                    \"Bead store returned {} candidates\",\n                    beads.len()\n                );\n                beads\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                tracing::error!(\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"Bead store query failed\"\n                );\n                // Bead store error is semantically different from NoWork.\n                return StrandResult::Error(StrandError::StoreError(e));\n            }\n        };\n\n        // Initialize filtering statistics for starvation telemetry.\n        let mut stats = FilteringStats {\n            open_count: candidates.len(),\n            ..Default::default()\n        };\n\n        // 2. Filter: remove beads with excluded labels.\n        //    Defensive guard — store.ready() passes exclude_labels in its Filters,\n        //    but the backing CLI may not include label data in every query type.\n        //    Filtering here guarantees excluded-label beads are never presented as\n        //    candidates regardless of backend behaviour, preventing the\n        //    SELECTING→CLAIMING→RETRYING spin loop observed when br ready --json\n        //    omits label fields for some beads.\n        let before_label_filter = candidates.len();\n\n        // First pass: collect excluded beads and their reasons for telemetry.\n        let excluded_beads: Vec<_> = candidates\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|b| b.labels.iter().any(|l| self.exclude_labels.contains(l)))\n            .map(|b| {\n                let excluded_labels: Vec<_> = b\n                    .labels\n                    .iter()\n                    .filter(|l| self.exclude_labels.contains(l))\n                    .cloned()\n                    .collect();\n                (b.id.as_ref().to_string(), excluded_labels)\n            })\n            .collect();\n\n        // Second pass: perform the actual filtering.\n        candidates.retain(|b| !b.labels.iter().any(|l| self.exclude_labels.contains(l)));\n        let after_label_filter = candidates.len();\n\n        if before_label_filter != after_label_filter {\n            let label_excluded_count = before_label_filter - after_label_filter;\n            stats.excluded_count += label_excluded_count;\n\n            tracing::debug!(\n                excluded_count = label_excluded_count,\n                remaining = after_label_filter,\n                excluded_labels = ?self.exclude_labels,\n                \"Label filtering excluded {} beads\",\n                label_excluded_count\n            );\n\n            // Log each excluded bead at DEBUG level and collect reasons for telemetry.\n            for (id, excluded_labels) in &excluded_beads {\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    bead_id = %id,\n                    labels = ?excluded_labels,\n                    \"Excluded bead due to labels\"\n                );\n\n                // Add to exclusion reasons for telemetry.\n                for label in excluded_labels {\n                    stats.exclusion_reasons.push(format!(\"label:{}\", label));\n                }\n            }\n        } else {\n            tracing::debug!(\n                count = after_label_filter,\n                \"No beads excluded by label filter\"\n            );\n        }\n\n        // 3. Filter: remove beads that are actively in_progress (claimed by another worker)\n        //    and Open beads with a stale assignee. These are never claimable — the claimer\n        //    will reject them every time, causing a hot loop.\n        let before_status_filter = candidates.len();\n\n        // First pass: collect excluded beads and their reasons for telemetry.\n        let excluded_by_status: Vec<_> = candidates\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|b| {\n                matches!(b.status, crate::types::BeadStatus::InProgress)\n                    || (b.status == crate::types::BeadStatus::Open && b.assignee.is_some())\n            })\n            .map(|b| {\n                let reason = if matches!(b.status, crate::types::BeadStatus::InProgress) {\n                    \"status:in_progress\".to_string()\n                } else {\n                    format!(\"assignee:{}\", b.assignee.as_ref().unwrap())\n                };\n                (b.id.as_ref().to_string(), reason)\n            })\n            .collect();\n\n        // Second pass: perform the actual filtering.\n        candidates.retain(|b| {\n            !(matches!(b.status, crate::types::BeadStatus::InProgress)\n                || (b.status == crate::types::BeadStatus::Open && b.assignee.is_some()))\n        });\n        let after_status_filter = candidates.len();\n\n        if before_status_filter != after_status_filter {\n            let status_excluded_count = before_status_filter - after_status_filter;\n            stats.excluded_count += status_excluded_count;\n\n            tracing::debug!(\n                filtered_count = status_excluded_count,\n                remaining = after_status_filter,\n                \"Status/assignee filtering removed {} beads\",\n                status_excluded_count\n            );\n\n            // Log each excluded bead at DEBUG level and collect reasons for telemetry.\n            for (id, reason) in &excluded_by_status {\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    bead_id = %id,\n                    reason = %reason,\n                    \"Excluded bead due to status/assignee\"\n                );\n\n                // Add to exclusion reasons for telemetry.\n                stats.exclusion_reasons.push(reason.clone());\n            }\n        } else {\n            tracing::debug!(\n                count = after_status_filter,\n                \"No beads excluded by status/assignee filter\"\n            );\n        }\n\n        // 4. Sort: deterministic (priority, created_at, id).\n        if !candidates.is_empty() {\n            let first = &candidates[0];\n            tracing::debug!(\n                total = candidates.len(),\n                first_bead_id = %first.id,\n                first_priority = first.priority,\n                first_created_at = %first.created_at,\n                \"Sorting {} candidates by (priority ASC, created_at ASC, id ASC)\",\n                candidates.len()\n            );\n        }\n        Self::sort_candidates(&mut candidates);\n\n        // 5. Check for split trigger: if the first candidate has accumulated\n        //    enough consecutive failures, dispatch a SPLIT instruction instead\n        //    of returning the bead for normal processing.\n        if self.split_after_failures > 0 {\n            if let Some(first_candidate) = candidates.first() {\n                let failure_count = Self::extract_failure_count(first_candidate);\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    bead_id = %first_candidate.id,\n                    failure_count = failure_count,\n                    threshold = self.split_after_failures,\n                    split_triggered = failure_count >= self.split_after_failures,\n                    \"Checking split trigger for first candidate\"\n                );\n\n                if failure_count >= self.split_after_failures {\n                    tracing::info!(\n                        bead_id = %first_candidate.id,\n                        failure_count = failure_count,\n                        threshold = self.split_after_failures,\n                        \"Split threshold reached, returning Split instruction\"\n                    );\n                    return StrandResult::Split(Box::new(first_candidate.clone()), failure_count);\n                }\n            }\n        } else {\n            tracing::debug!(\"Split trigger disabled (threshold = 0)\");\n        }\n\n        // 6. Store filtering stats for telemetry access and return result.\n        // These fields persist on the strand instance for access by telemetry emission.\n        self.last_open_count\n            .store(stats.open_count, Ordering::Relaxed);\n        self.last_excluded_count\n            .store(stats.excluded_count, Ordering::Relaxed);\n        *self.last_exclusion_reasons.lock().unwrap() = stats.exclusion_reasons.clone();\n\n        if candidates.is_empty() {\n            // Extract workspace path from store for telemetry.\n            // All beads in a single store should have the same workspace.\n            // Follow KnotStrand pattern (src/strand/knot.rs lines 224-233).\n            let workspace_path = if let Ok(beads) = store.list_all().await {\n                beads\n                    .first()\n                    .and_then(|b| b.workspace.to_str().map(|s| s.to_string()))\n                    .unwrap_or_else(|| \"unknown\".to_string())\n            } else {\n                \"unknown\".to_string()\n            };\n\n            // Emit PluckStarvationDetected telemetry event with filtering statistics.\n            let _ = self\n                .telemetry\n                .emit(crate::telemetry::EventKind::PluckStarvationDetected {\n                    workspace: workspace_path.clone(),\n                    open_count: stats.open_count,\n                    excluded_count: stats.excluded_count,\n                    candidate_exclusion_reasons: stats.exclusion_reasons.clone(),\n                });\n\n            // Write persistent starvation record to NEEDLE workspace if enabled.\n            if self.persistent_starvation_records {\n                if let Err(e) = self.write_starvation_record(\n                    &workspace_path,\n                    stats.open_count,\n                    stats.excluded_count,\n                    &stats.exclusion_reasons,\n                ) {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                        error = %e,\n                        \"Failed to write persistent starvation record\"\n                    );\n                }\n            }\n\n            tracing::debug!(\n                workspace = %workspace_path,\n                open_count = stats.open_count,\n                excluded_count = stats.excluded_count,\n                \"Emitted PluckStarvationDetected telemetry, returning NoWork\"\n            );\n            StrandResult::NoWork\n        } else {\n            let candidate_ids: Vec<&str> = candidates.iter().map(|b| b.id.as_ref()).collect();\n            tracing::info!(\n                count = candidates.len(),\n                candidates = ?candidate_ids,\n                \"Returning {} candidates for processing\",\n                candidates.len()\n            );\n            StrandResult::BeadFound(candidates)\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ─── Unit tests make_bead(\"m-bead-2\", 1, \"2026-01-01 00:00:00\"),\n        ];\n\n        let strand = PluckStrand::new(vec![], Telemetry::new(\"test-worker\".to_string()));\n\n        let store1 = MemoryStore {\n panic!(\"candidate_exclusion_reasons should be an array\");\n            }\n        } else {\n            panic!(\"candidate_exclusion_reasons field missing from starvation event\");\n        }\n ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Where a configuration value originated.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum ConfigSource {\n    /// Built-in default value.\n    Default,\n    /// Global config file (`~/.config/needle/config.yaml`).\n    GlobalFile(PathBuf),\n    /// Workspace config file (`.needle.yaml`).\n    WorkspaceFile(PathBuf),\n    /// Environment variable override.\n    EnvVar(String),\n    /// CLI argument override.\n    CliOverride,\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for ConfigSource {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            ConfigSource::Default => write!(f, \"built-in default\"),\n            ConfigSource::GlobalFile(p) => write!(f, \"{}\", p.display()),\n            ConfigSource::WorkspaceFile(p) => write!(f, \"{}\", p.display()),\n            ConfigSource::EnvVar(name) => write!(f, \"{} env var\", name),\n            ConfigSource::CliOverride => write!(f, \"CLI argument\"),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Map of config field paths to their source.\n///\n/// Used by `needle config --dump --show-source` to annotate each value.\npub type SourceMap = BTreeMap<String, ConfigSource>;\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Workspace Overrides\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Subset of configuration that can be overridden per-workspace via `.needle.yaml`.\n///\n/// Only these sections are ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Top-level Config\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Fully resolved NEEDLE configuration.\n///\n/// Loaded once at boot, immutable during a session.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct Config {\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub agent: AgentConfig,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub worker: WorkerConfig,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub workspace: WorkspaceConfig,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub strands: StrandsConfig,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub telemetry: TelemetryConfig,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub prompt: PromptConfig,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub health: HealthConfig,\n    /// Provider/model concurrency and rate limits.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub limits: LimitsConfig,\n    /// Per-model token pricing (USD per million tokens).\n    #[serde(default = \"crate::cost::default_pricing\")]\n    pub pricing: PricingConfig,\n    /// Daily budget thresholds for cost enforcement.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub budget: BudgetConfig,\n    /// Verification commands run after agent success, before accepting closure.\n    /// Legacy format — prefer `gates` for new configurations.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub verification: Vec<String>,\n    /// Pluggable validation gates.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub gates: Vec<GateConfig>,\n    /// Self-modification (hot-reload) configuration.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub self_modification: SelfModificationConfig,\n    /// FABRIC live dashboard forwarding.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub fabric: FabricConfig,\n    /// Supervisor detection configuration.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub supervisor: SupervisorConfig,\n}\n\nimpl Config {\n    /// Expand all tilde (~) paths to absolute paths using $HOME.\n    ///\n    /// This must be called after deserialization to ensure all paths\n    /// like `~/.needle` are expanded to `/home/user/.needle`.\n    /// Paths without tildes are left unchanged.\n    pub fn expand_tildes(&mut self) {\n        // workspace section\n        self.workspace.default = expand_tilde(&self.workspace.default);\n        self.workspace.home = expand_tilde(&self.workspace.home);\n\n        // agent section\n        self.agent.adapters_dir = expand_tilde(&self.agent.adapters_dir);\n\n        // strands.explore section\n        self.strands.explore.workspace_root = expand_tilde(&self.strands.explore.workspace_root);\n        self.strands.explore.workspaces = expand_tilde_vec(&self.strands.explore.workspaces);\n\n        // strands.weave section\n        self.strands.weave.exclude_workspaces =\n            expand_tilde_vec(&self.strands.weave.exclude_workspaces);\n\n        // strands.splice section\n        self.strands.splice.report_workspace =\n            expand_tilde_option(&self.strands.splice.report_workspace);\n\n        // strands.pulse.scanners[].command paths are strings, not PathBuf, so skip\n\n        // strands.reflect section - no PathBuf fields\n\n        // strands.learning section\n        self.strands.learning.global_learnings_file =\n            expand_tilde(&self.strands.learning.global_learnings_file);\n\n        // telemetry section\n        if let Some(ref mut log_dir) = self.telemetry.file_sink.log_dir {\n            *log_dir = expand_tilde(log_dir);\n        }\n\n        // health section\n        self.health.heartbeat_dir = expand_tilde_option(&self.health.heartbeat_dir);\n\n        // supervisor section\n        self.supervisor.heartbeat_path = expand_tilde_option(&self.supervisor.heartbeat_path);\n        self.supervisor.socket_path = expand_tilde_option(&self.supervisor.socket_path);\n\n        // prompt section\n        self.prompt.context_files = expand_tilde_vec(&self.prompt.context_files);\n\n        // self_modification section\n        self.self_modification.canary_workspace =\n            expand_tilde(&self.self_modification.canary_workspace);\n\n        // prompt.variants[].content_file\n        for variants in self.prompt.variants.values_mut() {\n            for variant in variants {\n                variant.content_file = expand_tilde(&variant.content_file);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Config validation\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// A single config validation error.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct ConfigError {\n    /// Dot-separated field path (e.g., `agent.default`).\n    pub field: String,\n    /// Human-readable explanation.\n    pub message: String,\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for ConfigError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        write!(f, \"{}: {}\", self.field, self.message)\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// CLI overrides\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// CLI-level overrides applied after all file-based config loading.\n#[derive(Debug, Default)]\npub struct CliOverrides {\n    pub workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n    pub worker_name: Option<String>,\n    pub agent_binary: Option<String>,\n    pub max_workers: Option<u32>,\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// ConfigLoader\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Loads and validates NEEDLE configuration.\npub struct ConfigLoader;\n\nimpl ConfigLoader {\n    /// Load global config from `~/.config/needle/config.yaml`.\n    ///\n    /// If the file does not exist, returns the default config (not an error).\n    pub fn load_global() -> Result<Config> {\n        let path = dirs_or_home(\".config/needle/config.yaml\");\n        Self::load_from_path(&path)\n    }\n\n orphaned_count: u32,\n    agent_completed_count: u32,\n    sample: Vec<String>,\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// HeartbeatRecord\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Heartbeat record deserialized from a worker's heartbeat file.\n#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, Clone)]\nstruct HeartbeatRecord {\n    worker_id: String,\n    pid: u32,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    state: String,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    current_bead: Option<String>,\n    workspace: String,\n    last_heartbeat: DateTime<Utc>,\n    session: String,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    beads_processed: u64,\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Loop detection types\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Type of live-loop pattern detected.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\nenum LoopType {\n    /// Repeated claim.race_lost events for the same bead.\n    ClaimChurn { bead_id: String, count: u32 },\n    /// Excessive JSONL growth without forward progress.\n    LogRunaway { bytes_growth: u64, window_secs: u64 },\n    /// State ping-pong between a small set of states.\n    StatePingPong {\n        states: Vec<String>,\n        cycle_count: u32,\n    },\n    /// Completion without resolution: many agent.completed events but bead never closes.\n    CompletionWithoutResolution {\n        bead_id: String,\n        claim_succeeded_count: u32,\n        orphaned_count: u32,\n        agent_completed_count: u32,\n    },\n}\n\n/// Evidence collected for a loop detection.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\nstruct LoopEvidence {\n    /// Number of events scanned from JSONL tail.\n    events_scanned: usize,\n    /// Sample of recent events showing the pattern.\n    sample_events: Vec<String>,\n    /// When the loop was detected.\n    detected_at: DateTime<Utc>,\n}\n\n/// A worker exhibiting a live-loop pattern.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\nstruct LiveLoopWorker {\n    /// The worker's heartbeat record.\n    heartbeat: HeartbeatRecord,\n    /// The type of loop detected.\n    loop_type: LoopType,\n    /// Evidence supporting the detection.\n    evidence: LoopEvidence,\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// SpliceState\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Persisted state for the Splice strand.\n#[derive(Debug, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]\nstruct SpliceState {\n    /// Session IDs that have already had a failure bead created (dead workers).\n    documented_sessions: HashSet<String>,\n    /// (worker_id, session_id, pattern_name) tuples already documented (live loops).\n    documented_loops: HashSet<String>,\n}\n\nimpl SpliceState {\n    /// Load state from the state directory, returning None if file doesn't exist.\n    fn load(state_dir: &Path) -> Result<Option<Self>> {\n        let path = state_dir.join(\"splice_state.json\");\n        if !path.exists() {\n            return Ok(None);\n        }\n        let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&path)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to read splice state: {}\", path.display()))?;\n        let state: SpliceState =\n            serde_json::from_str(&content).with_context(|| \"failed to parse splice state\")?;\n        Ok(Some(state))\n    }\n\n    /// Save state to the state directory.\n    fn save(&self, state_dir: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(state_dir)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to create state dir: {}\", state_dir.display()))?;\n        let path = state_dir.join(\"splice_state.json\");\n        let content = serde_json::to_string_pretty(self)?;\n        std::fs::write(&path, content)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to write splice state: {}\", path.display()))?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// SpliceStrand\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// The Splice strand — worker failure documentation.\n///\n/// Scans heartbeat files for dead workers and creates failure beads.\npub struct SpliceStrand {\n    config: SpliceConfig,\n    heartbeat_dir: PathBuf,\n    state_dir: PathBuf,\n    #[allow(dead_code)]\n    telemetry: Telemetry,\n}\n\nimpl SpliceStrand {\n    /// Create a new SpliceStrand.\n    ///\n    /// - `config`: splice strand configuration\n    /// - `heartbeat_dir`: directory containing worker heartbeat JSON files\n    /// - `state_dir`: directory for persisting splice state\n    /// - `telemetry`: telemetry emitter\n    pub fn new(\n        config: SpliceConfig,\n        heartbeat_dir: PathBuf,\n        state_dir: PathBuf,\n        telemetry: Telemetry,\n    ) -> Self {\n        SpliceStrand {\n            config,\n            heartbeat_dir,\n            state_dir,\n            telemetry,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Derive the JSONL log path for a worker's session.\n    ///\n    /// Format: `<log_dir>/<worker_id>-<session_id>.jsonl`\n    fn worker_log_path(&self, worker_id: &str, session_id: &str) -> Option<PathBuf> {\n        // Try to get log_dir from the heartbeat record's workspace.\n        // Default to ~/.needle/logs if not configured.\n        let log_dir =\n            std::env::var_os(\"HOME\").map(|h| PathBuf::from(h).join(\".needle\").join(\"logs\"))?;\n\n        Some(log_dir.join(format!(\"{}-{}.jsonl\", worker_id, session_id)))\n    }\n\n    /// Read the last N events from a JSONL file.\n    ///\n    /// Returns lines in reverse order (newest first), limited to scan_events.\n    fn read_jsonl_tail(&self, path: &Path, scan_events: usize) -> Result<Vec<String>> {\n        let content = std::fs::read_to_string(path)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to read jsonl: {}\", path.display()))?;\n\n        let lines: Vec<&str> = content.lines().collect();\n        let tail_len = scan_events.min(lines.len());\n        let mut tail = Vec::with_capacity(tail_len);\n\n        for line in lines.iter().rev().take(tail_len) {\n            tail.push(line.to_string());\n        }\n\n        Ok(tail)\n    }\n\n    /// Scan live workers for loop patterns.\n    ///\n    /// Returns workers with fresh heartbeats that exhibit stuck-loop behavior.\n    fn scan_live_loops(&self) -> Result<Vec<LiveLoopWorker>> {\n        let mut looping = Vec::new();\n\n        if !self.config.detect_live_loops {\n            return Ok(looping);\n        }\n\n        let entries = match std::fs::read_dir(&self.heartbeat_dir) {\n            Ok(e) => e,\n            Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {\n                tracing::debug!(\"splice: heartbeat directory does not exist\");\n                return Ok(Vec::new());\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                return Err(e).context(\"failed to read heartbeat directory\");\n            }\n        };\n\n        for entry in entries {\n            let entry = match entry {\n                Ok(e) => e,\n                Err(_) => continue,\n            };\n\n            let path = entry.path();\n            if path.extension().and_then(|s| s.to_str()) != Some(\"json\") {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            // Parse the heartbeat file.\n            let content = match std::fs::read_to_string(&path) {\n                Ok(c) => c,\n                Err(_) => continue,\n            };\n\n            let record: HeartbeatRecord = match serde_json::from_str(&content) {\n                Ok(r) => r,\n                Err(_) => continue,\n            };\n\n            // Skip stale heartbeats — those are handled by scan_failed_workers.\n            let elapsed = Utc::now() - record.last_heartbeat;\n            let stale_threshold_secs = self.config.stale_threshold_secs as i64;\n            if elapsed.num_seconds() >= stale_threshold_secs {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            // Check for loop patterns in the JSONL tail.\n            let log_path = match self.worker_log_path(&record.worker_id, &record.session) {\n                Some(p) => p,\n                None => continue,\n            };\n\n            if !log_path.exists() {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            if let Some(loop_worker) = self.check_worker_for_loops(&record, &log_path)? {\n                looping.push(loop_worker);\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(looping)\n    }\n\n    /// Check a single worker's JSONL for loop patterns.\n    ///\n    /// Returns Some(LiveLoopWorker) if a pattern is detected, None otherwise.\n    fn check_worker_for_loops(\n        &self,\n        record: &HeartbeatRecord,\n        log_path: &Path,\n    ) -> Result<Option<LiveLoopWorker>> {\n        let tail_events = self.read_jsonl_tail(log_path, self.config.live_loop_scan_events)?;\n\n        // Parse events into structured form for analysis.\n        let mut events: Vec<TelemetryEventLike> = Vec::new();\n        for line in &tail_events {\n            if let Ok(ev) = serde_json::from_str::<TelemetryEventLike>(line) {\n                events.push(ev);\n            }\n        }\n\n        let detected_at = Utc::now();\n\n        // Pattern 1: Claim churn — repeated race_lost for same bead.\n        if let Some(churn) = self.detect_claim_churn(&events) {\n            return Ok(Some(LiveLoopWorker {\n                heartbeat: record.clone(),\n                loop_type: LoopType::ClaimChurn {\n                    bead_id: churn.bead_id,\n                    count: churn.count,\n                },\n                evidence: LoopEvidence {\n                    events_scanned: tail_events.len(),\n                    sample_events: churn.sample,\n                    detected_at,\n                },\n            }));\n        }\n\n        // Pattern 2: State ping-pong — short cycle without forward progress.\n        if let Some(pingpong) = self.detect_state_ping_pong(&events) {\n            return Ok(Some(LiveLoopWorker {\n                heartbeat: record.clone(),\n                loop_type: LoopType::StatePingPong {\n                    states: pingpong.states,\n                    cycle_count: pingpong.cycle_count,\n                },\n                evidence: LoopEvidence {\n                    events_scanned: tail_events.len(),\n                    sample_events: pingpong.sample,\n                    detected_at,\n                },\n            }));\n        }\n\n        // Pattern 3: Log runaway — excessive growth without completion.\n        // This requires checking file metadata, not just event content.\n        if let Some(runaway) = self.detect_log_runaway(record, log_path, &events)? {\n            return Ok(Some(LiveLoopWorker {\n                heartbeat: record.clone(),\n                loop_type: LoopType::LogRunaway {\n                    bytes_growth: runaway.bytes_growth,\n                    window_secs: runaway.window_secs,\n                },\n                evidence: LoopEvidence {\n                    events_scanned: tail_events.len(),\n                    sample_events: runaway.sample,\n                    detected_at,\n                },\n            }));\n        }\n\n        Ok(None)\n    }\n\n    /// Detect claim churn: repeated race_lost events for the same bead.\n    fn detect_claim_churn(&self, events: &[TelemetryEventLike]) -> Option<ClaimChurnInfo> {\n        let mut race_lost_counts: HashMap<String, u32> = HashMap::new();\n        let mut sample: Vec<String> = Vec::new();\n\n        for ev in events.iter().rev() {\n            if ev.event_type == \"bead.claim.race_lost\" {\n                if let Some(bead_id) = &ev.bead_id {\n                    *race_lost_counts.entry(bead_id.clone()).or_insert(0) += 1;\n                    if sample.len() < 10 {\n                        sample.push(format!(\"{} race_lost {}\", ev.timestamp, bead_id));\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        for (bead_id, count) in &race_lost_counts {\n            if *count >= self.config.claim_churn_threshold {\n                return Some(ClaimChurnInfo {\n                    bead_id: bead_id.clone(),\n                    count: *count,\n                    sample,\n                });\n            }\n        }\n\n        None\n    }\n\n    /// Detect state ping-pong: short state cycles without forward progress.\n    fn detect_state_ping_pong(&self, events: &[TelemetryEventLike]) -> Option<StatePingPongInfo> {\n        // Look for state_transition events and extract state sequences.\n        let mut state_transitions: Vec<(DateTime<Utc>, String, String)> = Vec::new();\n\n        for ev in events.iter().rev() {\n            if ev.event_type == \"worker.state_transition\" {\n                if let (Some(from), Some(to)) = (&ev.data.get(\"from\"), &ev.data.get(\"to\")) {\n                    if let (Some(from_str), Some(to_str)) = (from.as_str(), to.as_str()) {\n                        state_transitions.push((\n                            ev.timestamp,\n                            from_str.to_string(),\n                            to_str.to_string(),\n                        ));\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if state_transitions.len() < 8 {\n            return None; // Not enough transitions to detect a cycle.\n        }\n\n        // Check for cycles of length <= 4 states.\n        let window_size = 8.min(state_transitions.len());\n        let window: Vec<_> = state_transitions\n            .iter()\n            .take(window_size)\n            .map(|(_, _, to)| to.clone())\n            .collect();\n\n        // Count unique states in the window.\n        let unique_states: HashSet<_> = window.iter().collect();\n\n        if unique_states.len() <= 4 && window.len() >= 6 {\n            // Check if we're cycling without forward-progress events.\n            let has_forward_progress = events\n                .iter()\n                .any(|ev| matches!(ev.event_type.as_str(), \"agent.completed\" | \"bead.completed\"));\n\n            if !has_forward_progress {\n                let sample = state_transitions\n                    .iter()\n                    .take(10)\n                    .map(|(ts, from, to)| format!(\"{} {} -> {}\", ts.format(\"%H:%M:%S\"), from, to))\n                    .collect();\n\n                return Some(StatePingPongInfo {\n                    states: unique_states.iter().map(|s| (*s).clone()).collect(),\n                    cycle_count: (window.len() / unique_states.len()) as u32,\n                    sample,\n                });\n            }\n        }\n\n        None\n    }\n\n    /// Detect log runaway: excessive file growth without completion events.\n    fn detect_log_runaway(\n        &self,\n        _record: &HeartbeatRecord,\n        log_path: &Path,\n        events: &[TelemetryEventLike],\n    ) -> Result<Option<LogRunawayInfo>> {\n        let metadata = std::fs::metadata(log_path)?;\n        let file_size = metadata.len();\n\n        // Check for agent.completed events in the scanned window.\n        let has_completed = events\n            .iter()\n            .any(|ev| ev.event_type == \"agent.completed\" || ev.event_type == \"bead.completed\");\n\n        if !has_completed && file_size > self.config.log_runaway_bytes {\n            // Calculate time window from oldest to newest event.\n            if let (Some(oldest), Some(newest)) = (events.first(), events.last()) {\n                let window_secs = (newest.timestamp - oldest.timestamp).num_seconds().max(1) as u64;\n\n                if window_secs <= self.config.live_loop_window_secs {\n                    let sample = events\n                        .iter()\n                        .rev()\n                        .take(10)\n                        .map(|ev| format!(\"{} {}\", ev.timestamp, ev.event_type))\n                        .collect();\n\n                    return Ok(Some(LogRunawayInfo {\n                        bytes_growth: file_size,\n                        window_secs,\n                        sample,\n                    }));\n                }\n            }\n\n            // If we can't calculate window but file is huge and no completion, still flag.\n            if file_size > self.config.log_runaway_bytes * 2 {\n                let sample = events\n                    .iter()\n                    .rev()\n                    .take(10)\n                    .map(|ev| format!(\"{} {}\", ev.timestamp, ev.event_type))\n                    .collect();\n\n                return Ok(Some(LogRunawayInfo {\n                    bytes_growth: file_size,\n                    window_secs: self.config.live_loop_window_secs,\n                    sample,\n                }));\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(None)\n    }\n\n    /// Detect completion without resolution: many agent.completed events but bead never closes.\n    ///\n    /// This detects the pattern where a bead is claimed, the agent completes successfully,\n    /// but the bead is orphaned (not closed) and then reclaimed—repeating indefinitely.\n    /// The key signal is N agent.completed events for the same bead with 0 bead.completed events.\n    fn detect_completion_without_resolution(\n        &self,\n        events: &[TelemetryEventLike],\n    ) -> Option<CompletionWithoutResolutionInfo> {\n        // Track event counts per bead_id\n        let mut claim_succeeded_counts: HashMap<String, u32> = HashMap::new();\n        let mut orphaned_counts: HashMap<String, u32> = HashMap::new();\n        let mut agent_completed_counts: HashMap<String, u32> = HashMap::new();\n        let mut bead_completed_seen: HashSet<String> = HashSet::new();\n        let mut sample: Vec<String> = Vec::new();\n\n        for ev in events.iter().rev() {\n            let bead_id = match &ev.bead_id {\n                Some(id) => id.clone(),\n                None => continue,\n            };\n\n            // Track relevant events\n            match ev.event_type.as_str() {\n                \"bead.claim.succeeded\" => {\n                    *claim_succeeded_counts.entry(bead_id.clone()).or_insert(0) += 1;\n                    if sample.len() < 10 {\n                        sample.push(format!(\"{} claim.succeeded {}\", ev.timestamp, bead_id));\n                    }\n                }\n                \"bead.orphaned\" => {\n                    *orphaned_counts.entry(bead_id.clone()).or_insert(0) += 1;\n                    if sample.len() < 10 {\n                        sample.push(format!(\"{} orphaned {}\", ev.timestamp, bead_id));\n                    }\n                }\n                \"agent.completed\" => {\n                    *agent_completed_counts.entry(bead_id.clone()).or_insert(0) += 1;\n                    if sample.len() < 10 {\n                        sample.push(format!(\"{} agent.completed {}\", ev.timestamp, bead_id));\n                    }\n                }\n                \"bead.completed\" => {\n                    bead_completed_seen.insert(bead_id);\n                }\n                _ => {}\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Check for beads with the problematic pattern:\n        // - High claim_succeeded count (indicating repeated claims)\n        // - High orphaned count (indicating the bead is being released without closure)\n        // - High agent_completed count (agents are succeeding)\n        // - NO bead.completed event (the bead never actually closes)\n        //\n        // The bf-34xw9 incident showed: 41 claim.succeeded, 25 orphaned, 42 agent.completed, 1 bead.completed\n        // We need thresholds that catch this pattern. Using claim_churn_threshold (20) as baseline.\n\n        for (bead_id, &agent_completed_count) in &agent_completed_counts {\n            // Skip if bead was completed (not stuck)\n            if bead_completed_seen.contains(bead_id) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            let claim_succeeded_count = claim_succeeded_counts.get(bead_id).copied().unwrap_or(0);\n            let orphaned_count = orphaned_counts.get(bead_id).copied().unwrap_or(0);\n\n            // Detect the pattern: high activity but no resolution\n            // Threshold: at least claim_churn_threshold agent.completed events\n            // AND significant claim/orphan activity (at least 5 each to avoid noise)\n            if agent_completed_count >= self.config.claim_churn_threshold\n                && claim_succeeded_count >= 5\n                && orphaned_count >= 5\n            {\n                return Some(CompletionWithoutResolutionInfo {\n                    bead_id: bead_id.clone(),\n                    claim_succeeded_count,\n                    orphaned_count,\n                    agent_completed_count,\n                    sample,\n                });\n            }\n        }\n\n        None\n    }\n\n    /// Scan for failed workers (stale heartbeat + dead tmux session).\n    ///\n    /// Returns a list of heartbeat records for workers that are considered dead.\n    fn scan_failed_workers(&self) -> Result<Vec<HeartbeatRecord>> {\n        let mut failed = Vec::new();\n\n        // Read all *.json files from heartbeat directory.\n        let entries = match std::fs::read_dir(&self.heartbeat_dir) {\n            Ok(e) => e,\n            Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {\n                tracing::debug!(\"splice: heartbeat directory does not exist\");\n                return Ok(Vec::new());\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                return Err(e).context(\"failed to read heartbeat directory\");\n            }\n        };\n\n        for entry in entries {\n            let entry = match entry {\n                Ok(e) => e,\n                Err(_) => continue,\n            };\n\n            let path = entry.path();\n            if path.extension().and_then(|s| s.to_str()) != Some(\"json\") {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            // Parse the heartbeat file.\n            let content = match std::fs::read_to_string(&path) {\n                Ok(c) => c,\n                Err(e) => {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                        path = %path.display(),\n                        error = %e,\n                        \"splice: failed to read heartbeat file\"\n                    );\n                    continue;\n                }\n            };\n\n            let record: HeartbeatRecord = match serde_json::from_str(&content) {\n                Ok(r) => r,\n                Err(e) => {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                        path = %path.display(),\n                        error = %e,\n                        \"splice: failed to parse heartbeat file\"\n                    );\n                    continue;\n                }\n            };\n\n            // Check if heartbeat is stale.\n            let elapsed = Utc::now() - record.last_heartbeat;\n            let stale_threshold_secs = self.config.stale_threshold_secs as i64;\n            if elapsed.num_seconds() < stale_threshold_secs {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            // Check if tmux session is still alive.\n            let alive = std::process::Command::new(\"tmux\")\n                .args([\"has-session\", \"-t\", &record.session])\n                .status()\n                .map(|s| s.success())\n                .unwrap_or(false);\n\n            if !alive {\n                // Session is dead — this is a failed worker.\n                failed.push(record);\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(failed)\n    }\n\n    /// Document a worker failure by creating a bead in the report workspace.\n    ///\n    /// If `report_workspace` is None or the workspace is invalid, returns Ok(())\n    /// without creating a bead.\n    async fn document_failure(&self, record: &HeartbeatRecord) -> Result<()> {\n        let report_workspace = match &self.config.report_workspace {\n            Some(ws) => ws,\n            None => {\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    worker_id = %record.worker_id,\n                    session = %record.session,\n                    \"splice: no report workspace configured, skipping bead creation\"\n                );\n                return Ok(());\n            }\n        };\n\n        // Verify the workspace exists and has a .beads/ subdirectory.\n        let beads_dir = report_workspace.join(\".beads\");\n        if !report_workspace.exists() || !beads_dir.exists() {\n            tracing::warn!(\n                workspace = %report_workspace.display(),\n                worker_id = %record.worker_id,\n                \"splice: report workspace does not exist or has no .beads/ directory\"\n            );\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n\n        // Instantiate bead store for the report workspace.\n        let store = BrCliBeadStore::discover(report_workspace.clone())\n            .context(\"failed to instantiate bead store for report workspace\")?;\n\n        // Build bead title.\n        let title = format!(\"Worker failure: {} ({})\", record.worker_id, record.session);\n\n        // Calculate elapsed time since last heartbeat.\n        let elapsed = Utc::now() - record.last_heartbeat;\n        let elapsed_secs = elapsed.num_seconds();\n        let elapsed_mins = elapsed_secs / 60;\n        let elapsed_hours = elapsed_mins / 60;\n        let elapsed_str = if elapsed_hours > 0 {\n            format!(\"{}h {}m\", elapsed_hours, elapsed_mins % 60)\n        } else if elapsed_mins > 0 {\n            format!(\"{}m\", elapsed_mins)\n        } else {\n            format!(\"{}s\", elapsed_secs)\n        };\n\n        // Build bead body.\n        let current_bead_str = record.current_bead.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"(none)\");\n        let body = format!(\n            \"## Worker Failure\\n\\n\\\n             **Worker:** {}\\n\\\n             **Session:** {}\\n\\\n             **Workspace:** {}\\n\\\n             **Last heartbeat:** {} ({} ago)\\n\\\n             **State at failure:** {}\\n\\\n             **Beads processed:** {}\\n\\\n             **Current bead:** {}\\n\\\n             **PID:** {}\\n\",\n            record.worker_id,\n            record.session,\n            record.workspace,\n            record.last_heartbeat.format(\"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC\"),\n            elapsed_str,\n            record.state,\n            record.beads_processed,\n            current_bead_str,\n            record.pid\n        );\n\n        // Create the bead.\n        let bead_id = store\n            .create_bead(&title, &body, &[\"worker-failure\", \"human\"])\n            .await\n            .context(\"failed to create worker failure bead\")?;\n\n        tracing::info!(\n            worker_id = %record.worker_id,\n            session = %record.session,\n            bead_id = %bead_id,\n            \"splice: documented worker failure\"\n        );\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Document a live-loop worker by creating a bead in the report workspace.\n    ///\n    /// If `report_workspace` is None or the workspace is invalid, returns Ok(())\n    /// without creating a bead.\n    async fn document_live_loop(&self, worker: &LiveLoopWorker) -> Result<()> {\n        let report_workspace = match &self.config.report_workspace {\n            Some(ws) => ws,\n            None => {\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    worker_id = %worker.heartbeat.worker_id,\n                    session = %worker.heartbeat.session,\n                    \"splice: no report workspace configured, skipping loop bead creation\"\n                );\n                return Ok(());\n            }\n        };\n\n        // Verify the workspace exists and has a .beads/ subdirectory.\n        let beads_dir = report_workspace.join(\".beads\");\n        if !report_workspace.exists() || !beads_dir.exists() {\n            tracing::warn!(\n                workspace = %report_workspace.display(),\n                worker_id = %worker.heartbeat.worker_id,\n                \"splice: report workspace does not exist or has no .beads/ directory\"\n            );\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n\n        // Instantiate bead store for the report workspace.\n        let store = BrCliBeadStore::discover(report_workspace.clone())\n Splice strand: worker failure documentation.\n//!\n//! Strand 8 in the waterfall (runs before Knot). Scans heartbeat files for\n//! workers with stale heartbeats whose tmux session is dead, and creates a\n//! failure bead in the configured report workspace for each undocumented failure.\n//!\n//! Also detects live-but-looping workers: workers with fresh heartbeats that are\n//! stuck in tight event loops (claim churn, state ping-pong, log runaway).\n//!\n//! Entry conditions:\n//! - `strands.splice.enabled` is true (default: true)\n//! - Heartbeat files exist in the heartbeat directory\n//! - At least one worker has a stale heartbeat and dead tmux session OR\n//!   a live worker exhibits loop patterns in its JSONL tail\n//!\n//! State persistence:\n//! - `splice_state.json` tracks which session IDs have already been documented\n//! - Prevents duplicate failure beads for the same dead/looping worker\n\nuse std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\n\nuse anyhow::{Context, Result};\nuse chrono::{DateTime, Utc};\nuse serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};\n\nuse ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// TelemetryEventLike (minimal subset for JSONL scanning)\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Minimal telemetry event representation for JSONL tail scanning.\n#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]\nstruct TelemetryEventLike {\n    timestamp: DateTime<Utc>,\n    event_type: String,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    bead_id: Option<String>,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    data: serde_json::Value,\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Loop detection result structures\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n#[derive(Debug)]\nstruct ClaimChurnInfo {\n    bead_id: String,\n    count: u32,\n    sample: Vec<String>,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug)]\nstruct StatePingPongInfo {\n    states: Vec<String>,\n    cycle_count: u32,\n    sample: Vec<String>,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug)]\nstruct LogRunawayInfo {\n    bytes_growth: u64,\n    window_secs: u64,\n    sample: Vec<String>,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug)]\nstruct CompletionWithoutResolutionInfo {\n    bead_id: String,\n    claim_succeeded_count: u32,\n    orphaned_count: u32,\n    agent_completed_count: u32,\n    sample: Vec<String>,\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// HeartbeatRecord\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Heartbeat record deserialized from a worker's heartbeat file.\n#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, Clone)]\nstruct HeartbeatRecord {\n    worker_id: String,\n    pid: u32,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    state: String,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    current_bead: Option<String>,\n    workspace: String,\n    last_heartbeat: DateTime<Utc>,\n    session: String,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    beads_processed: u64,\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Loop Repeated claim.race_lost events for the same bead.\n    ClaimChurn { bead_id: String, count: u32 },\n    /// Excessive JSONL growth without forward progress.\n    LogRunaway { bytes_growth: u64, window_secs: u64 },\n    /// State ping-pong between a small set of states.\n    StatePingPong {\n        states: Vec<String>,\n        cycle_count: u32,\n    },\n    /// Completion without agent_completed_count: u32,\n    },\n}\n\n/// Evidence collected for a loop detection.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\nstruct LoopEvidence {\n    /// Number of events scanned from JSONL tail.\n    events_scanned: usize,\n    /// Sample of recent events showing the pattern.\n    sample_events: Vec<String>,\n    /// When the loop was detected.\n    detected_at: DateTime<Utc>,\n}\n\n/// A worker SpliceState\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Persisted state for the Splice strand.\n#[derive(Debug, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]\nstruct
